content:
الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ونستغفره، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا، ومن سيئات أعمالنا
وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن سيدنا محمدًا عبده ورسوله.

The Quran is unique not only because of the breadth of its subjects but also because of its teaching approach that involves the use of demonstrations and examples to make its lessons clearer.

Regarding the breadth of the topics in the Quran, Allah says:

وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبَ تِبۡيَـٰنً۬ا لِّكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ۬ وَهُدً۬ى وَرَحۡمَةً۬ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ (٨٩)

We have sent down to you the Book (the Qur’an) as an exposition of everything, a guidance, a mercy, and glad tidings for the Muslims. (Al-Nahl 16:89)

Regarding the approach that the Quran uses to make the lessons clear, Allah says:

وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ۬ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورً۬ا (٨٩)

“And indeed, We have displayed for mankind in this Qur’an all kinds of similitudes, but most of mankind refused to do anything but reject.” (Al-Isra 17:89)

The subjects in the Quran and the examples given are intended not only to develop Muslims’ beliefs and character but also to develop the Muslims cognitive, intellectual and communication abilities.

In this talk I’ll inshallah focus on the Quranic approach to improving the communication skills of Muslims.

Effective communication is required to make sure that there are no misunderstandings between people. There are several elements for ensuring successful communications with the two key elements are:

1. Clarity/conciseness and
2. Truthfulness/openness.

In the same way, the two major impediments to effective communication are:

1. Not using concise words or using words that have double meaning, and
2. Using faulty logic or fallacious reasoning.

## Proper Choice of Words

Allah teaches us that when we speak, we should not use words that can become derogatory by tongue twisting or in foreign languages. Allah says:

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقُولُوا رَاعِنَا وَقُولُوا انْظُرْنَا) البقرة)

“O’ you who believe, do not say (to the Prophet) “Ra ina” but say “Un Zurna” (Al-Baqara 2:104)

The companions used to call the Prophet’s attention by saying “Ra’ina” (رَاعِنَا) that means “take care of us” and “consider our condition when guiding us”.

The word (رَاعِنَا) is related to title used for the shepherd (راعى الغنم) who is responsible to taking care of his flock by guiding them to the proper and safe places of feed. Also, the term is used in the hadeath (كلم راع وكلكم مسئول عن رعيته) “Everyone is shepherd and is responsible for his flock.”

So, the word (رَاعِنَا) is proper word, but Allah prohibited Muslims from using it because by minor tongue-twisting it becomes similar to a derogatory word in Hebrew. In Hebrew, the word ([r], phonetically “Rah” (رع)) means bad, evil, and wicked. Some of Jews started using it when addressing the Prophet (PBUH) as hidden insult.

(https://www.biblestudytools.com/lexicons/hebrew/nas/ra.html ).

To ensure against the wicked use of the word (رَاعِنَا), Allah commanded Muslims to use instead a word (انْظُرْنَا) that means “ look at us” and “give our condition your attention” which is the same meaning as the word (رَاعِنَا) but it can neither be tongue twisted nor it has negative meaning in other languages.

It is interesting that 1972 Esso applied this lesson and changed its name to Exxon. The term Esso in the Japanese language means “stalled car”, “a car that ran poorly” (like “clunker” in English). In selecting a new name, the company searched for a name that has no negative meaning in every known language and they selected “Exxon”.

This command from Allah demands us to always be careful in our choice of words and always choose proper words when we speak to avoid the wrong interpretation. It is also important for us to know the definition of the words we use to ensure that we use them properly.

This command of prohibiting the use of a good word because it can be abused is part of the Fiqh rule: cutting the pretext (سد الذرائع). This rule is often used by Muslim jurists to prohibit certain lawful transaction because it can be abused. But excessive application of the rule of cutting the pretext can also cause problems.

So, the first element of effective communication is the use of proper and concise words.

## Avoid the use of logical fallacies

The second important element of effective communications is to avoid the use of faulty logic, fallacious reasoning or logical fallacies. Logical fallacies are often used by those who are not truthful to support an argument to exploit, confuse or manipulate the listeners.

Recognizing the use of logical fallacies (المغالطات المنطقية) is not only important to ensure that you don’t use them when presenting your argument but also to ensure that no one can trick you into agreement by using them in his presentation.

You can easily recognize many of the logical fallacies by the arguments that the disbelievers used to make to justify their rejection of the messengers whom Allah sent to them. Allah classified these logical fallacies used by the disbelievers as void/false (باطل). Allah says:

وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ‌ۚ وَيُجَـٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلۡبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ‌ۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَـٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُواْ هُزُوً۬ا (٥٦) الكهف

“We do not send the messengers except as bearers of good tidings and warners, and those who disbelieve argue based on falsehood in order to nullify the truth with it; and they have taken My signs, and the warnings as mockery.” (Al-Kahf 18:56)

These logical fallacies are often used by politicians to argue against the position of their opponents and these days, they are often used in many internet forums.

The first of these fallacies that is very obvious in the argument of the disbelievers is what is known as Ad Hominem (الشخصنة) fallacy. Ad hominem is Latin for “against the man.” Ad hominem involves the use of personal attacks and insults as if they are an argument or evidence in support of a conclusion.

Instead of advancing good sound reasoning, the disbelievers used to make personal attacks against the messengers as if they are logical argumentation. The Quran records for us the use of the disbelievers of this fallacy in many verses such as:

وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ۬ كَذَّابٌ (٤)

“And the disbelievers said: “He is a sorcerer, a sheer liar.” (Sad 38:4)

كَذَٲلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ (٥٢)

“Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them, but they said: “A sorcerer or a madman!”” (Al-Dhariyat 51: 52)

أَءُلۡقِىَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ۬ (٢٥)

“Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Salih] alone from among us? No, he is an insolent liar!” (Al-Qamar 54:25)

وَيَقُولُونَ أَٮِٕنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ۬ مَّجۡنُونِۭ (٣٦) الصافات

“And used to say, “Are we really to leave our gods because of an insane poet?” (Al-Saffat 37:36)

This ad hominem fallacy of rejecting someone’s opinion on the basis of personal background is often used in Islamic debates. A person who are graduated from religious universities discredits anyone who is not graduated from religious universities when he discusses a religious issue on the ground that he is not qualified without even attempting to present serious counter argument.

The opposite is true, the person who is graduated from science universities attacks a person who is graduated from religious universities when he interprets scientific verses in the Quran on the ground that he is not qualified.

Once I listened to a TV debate between Dr. Zaghloul El Naggar (زغلول النجار) who hold Ph.D in geology from the University of Wales and publishes heavily on Scientific Concepts in the Quran and Dr. Abdul Sabbour Shaheen (د. عبد الصبور شاهين) who wrote a book entitled (أبي آدم. قصة الخليفة بين الأسطورة والحقيقة) “My Father Adam, the story of man’s creation between myth and Truth” in which he presented the case from the Quran that Adam was not the first human on earth. He argued that Adam was the father of man but not the father of humans (أن آدم هو أبو الإنسان وليس أبا البشر).

Instead of presenting counter explanation of the verses of the Quran to refute the thesis of Dr. Abdul Sabbour book, all what Dr. Zaghloul did is to attack Dr. Abdul Sabbour that he is not a scientist to understand this topic and he should not have written this book because Dr. Abdul Sabbour is merely a professor of Arabic and Islamic Studies.

The Ad Hominem fallacy is only used by those who have no logical argument to present and therefore, they distract from serious debate by using insults and personal attacks.

This fallacy is commonly used in politics to manipulate voters by appealing to irrelevant name-calling instead of addressing core issues. In this last election cycle, personal attacks were often used such as: “Crooked Hillary, “Wicked Witch of the West Wing,” “Low Energy Jeb”, “Lyin’ Ted”, “Truly weird Rand Paul”, “Little Marco”, etc.

As an advice to myself and to you is to never use this Ad Hominem fallacy when discussing a matter with your wife or children. Insulting them, raising your voice and getting angry are only signs that you do not have good argument. So, admit that you don’t know and let it go.

The second form of the logical fallacies that the disbelievers used is known as the Strawman Argument (رجل القش). This Strawman argument is named after the harmless, scarecrow. In the strawman argument, the person attacks a loosely equivalent yet unrelated position which the opponent never intended to make anyway.

The strawman arguments and ad hominem fallacies can occur together. The disbelievers often used these two fallacies together. The master of this was Fir’aun.

Prophets Musa and Haroun went to the Pharaoh asking him to release the Israelite from their bondage by saying:

إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسۡرَٲٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡ‌ۖ (٤٧)

“We are the messengers of your Lord. So, let the children of Israel go with us, and do not persecute them. (Taha 20:47)

Instead of making a real argument why he should not release the children of Israel, Fir’aun (the Pharaoh) used both the Strawman Argument and the Ad Hominem fallacy to distract from the real issue. Here are some of the distractions made by Fir’aun:

قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ (٥١)

“He said, “Then, what about the earlier generations?” (Taha 20:57)

The status of the earlier generation who are already dead has nothing to do with what Prophet Musa is asking for. Then Fir’aun also said:

قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ (٥٧)

“He Said, O’ Musa “Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your sorcery?” (Taha 20:57)

Prophet Musa never even hinted to driving the Egyptian form their land, but Fir’aun wanted to draw the argument with Musa in a different direction.

Fir’aun (Pharaoh) continued his Strawman argument and added to it the insults by saying:

وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِى قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِى مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرُ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِىٓ‌ۖ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ (٥١) أَمۡ أَنَا۟ خَيۡرٌ۬ مِّنۡ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ۬ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ (٥٢) فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِىَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٌ۬ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ (٥٣) ]سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف[

“And (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying, “Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers are flowing right underneath me? Do you, then, not discern? (51)

Or (do you not see that) I am much better than this one (Musa) who is worthless and can hardly express himself? (52)

So why were the bracelets of gold not sent down to him, or (why) did the angels not come along with him as companions?” (Al-Zukhruf 43:51-53)

The same Tactics were used against other Prophets. When Prophet Saleh came to the people of Thamud, they caused the distraction by making irrelevant statements instead of arguing against his message to them, they said:

فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرً۬ا مِّنَّا وَٲحِدً۬ا نَّتَّبِعُهُ ۥۤ إِنَّآ إِذً۬ا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ۬ وَسُعُرٍ (٢٤) أَءُلۡقِىَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ۬ (٢٥)

“And they said: “shall we follow one human being from among us? We will then be in error and insanity! Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Salih] alone from among us? No, he is an insolent liar!” (Al-Qamar 54:24-25)

Instead of presenting any valid argument against the Quran that was revealed to them, the disbelievers’ argument was to ask for another Quran

وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡہِمۡ ءَايَاتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ۬‌ۙ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا ٱئۡتِ بِقُرۡءَانٍ غَيۡرِ هَـٰذَآ أَوۡ بَدِّلۡهُ‌ۚ

And when Our Clear Verses are recited unto them, those who do not want to meet Us, say: Bring us a Qur’an other than this, or change it.” (Yunus 10:15)

This similar to when you make a good argument and your opponent’s counter argument is asking you to say something else.

When Prophet Shu‘aib was sent to the people of Madian, He said to them:

وَيَـٰقَوۡمِ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ‌ۖ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوْا فِى ٱلۡأَرْضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ (٨٥)

“And O my people! Perfect the measure and balance with justice and do not short the people of their things, and do not go around the earth spreading mischief.” (Hud 11:85) Their argument was:

قَالُواْ يَـٰشُعَيۡبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأۡمُرُكَ أَن نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوۡ أَن نَّفۡعَلَ فِىٓ أَمۡوَٲلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُاْ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلۡحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ (٨٧)

They said: “O Shu‘aib! Does your prayer command you that we give up what our fathers used to worship, or that we should not deal with our wealth as we wish? (We thought) you are the man of wisdom and guidance.” (Hud 11:87)

Prophet Shu‘aib never inhibited them from having freedom with their wealth, all he asked them is to be honest and just when dealing with others but instead of discussing his command, they changed the subject to something else.

A third form of logical fallacies is the appeal to authority (استخدام السلطة أو التوسل بالسُّلطة). This fallacy involves citing authorities even when the person cites irrelevant authorities, poor authorities, or false authorities for the purpose of steering away from real evidence.

The disbelievers often used this fallacy by invoking the authority of their fathers or their leaders.

قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا ۖ) الأعراف)

“They said: “You have come to us that we should worship Allah Alone and forsake that which our fathers used to worship.” (Al-Araf 7:70)

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَآ أَلۡفَيۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ‌ۗ أَوَلَوۡ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ شَيۡـًٔ۬ا وَلَا يَهۡتَدُونَ (١٧٠)

“When it is said to them: “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say: “We follow that on which we have found our fathers.” Is it so, even though their fathers had no understanding at all, and had no guidance?” (Al-Baqara 2:170)

وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحقُّ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحۡرٌ۬ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ (٣٠) وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ۬ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ۬ (٣١)) الزخرف

“And when the truth came to them, they (the disbelievers) said: “This is magic, and we totally disbelieve in it.” (30) And they say: “Why this Quran was not revealed on a great man of the two towns (Makkah and Tâif)?” (Al-Zukhruf 43:31)

The appealing to authority can be fallacy because even authorities can be wrong. As example, the science experts in the 16th century thought the Earth was the center of the solar system and this turned out to be wrong.

Also, until the late 1990s, scientists thought that gravity must be slowing down the expansion of the universe. Recent discoveries confirmed that the universe is expanding in far faster speed which has changed everything scientists originally knew about the cosmos.

This fallacy is often used in marketing to justify the quality and the value of products by using famous athletes as spokespersons, but that doesn’t make the athlete a relevant authority when it comes to product. This is a fallacy of irrelevant authority.

While most of what I present to you is from references, other than quoting the Quran and the authentic hadeath, I don’t give names of references because I want you to accept or reject any thing I say based on its own merit and not based on who said it.

I also asking you that when you inform anyone of an interpretation that you heard from me, don’t refer to me, if you get convinced with it, it will be yours when you share it. If you are not convinced with what I said, don’t share it with anyone. Your responsibility when you read or hear anything is to analyze it and only accept what you consider proper.

In my Dua, I always say (اللهم اجعلنا ممن يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه) that means O’ Allah make us of those who listen and follow what is best. This is a quote from Surat Al-Zumur (39:18) in which Allah describes the believing servants (قُلۡ يَا عِبَادِ) by saying about them:

ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُ ۥۤ‌ۚ أُوْلَـٰٓٮِٕكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ‌ۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَـٰبِ (١٨)

“Those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, and those are the ones who possess understanding.” (Al-Zumur 39:18)

Imam Ibn Hazm (ابن حزم) said:

ابن حزم حيث قال: لا يحل لأحد أن يأخذ قول أحد غير رسول الله -صلى الله عليه وسلم- بلا برهان)

“It is prohibited to follow the opinion of anyone without a proof except the Prophet (PBUH)”

Obviously, the only proofs that are acceptable to support any religious opinion are quotes from the Quran and the authentic Hadeath.

Even when it comes to Allah’s revelation, Allah informs that prophet’s (PBUH) role is only to deliver and explain the revelation and it is up to the people to reflect on it. Alalh says in Surat Al-Nahl:

وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡہِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ (٤٤)

“And We have also sent down unto you (O Muhammad SAW) the Dhikr (the Quran), that you may explain clearly to the people what is sent down to them, and that they may give thought” (Al-Nahl 16:44) “

Look at this verse, the Prophet’s role is to explain the revelation but you are I have the responsibility to give it our serious thought. Allah did not say, “that they may follow you, Allah said “that they may think”; Allah wants us to think and no follow blindly.

A fourth form of logical fallacies is appealing to Ignorance (الاحتكام إلي الجهل). Using ignorance as a major premise to support an argument is cheap and manipulative.

Disbelievers often used this fallacy by claiming that they have never heard of this message before, therefore it must be false. As example:

أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأَلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهً۬ا وَٲحِدًا‌ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىۡءٌ عُجَابٌ۬ (٥)

“Has he made all the gods into One God. This is a very strange thing, indeed!”” (Sad 38:5)

مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِہَـٰذَا فِى ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأَخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَـٰقٌ (٧)

“We never heard of this in the religion of the past. This is nothing but an invention!” (Sad 38:7)

فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ۬ قَالُواْ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٌ۬ مُّفۡتَرً۬ى وَمَا سَمِعۡنَا بِہَـٰذَا فِى ءَابَآٮِٕنَا ٱلۡأوَّلِينَ (٣٦)

“So when Musa came to them with Our clear signs, they said, “This is nothing but a forged magic, and we have never heard this in the days of our forefathers.” (Al-Qasas 28:36)

It is interesting that using ignorance as a major premise can be used to support contradictory conclusions such as:

“No one has ever been able to prove definitively that extra-terrestrials exist, so they must not be real.”

“No one has ever been able to prove definitively that extra-terrestrials do not exist, so they must be real.”

I’ll stop with these four logical fallacies and inshallah in future talks, we can discuss other fallacies and how that have been used by the disbelievers. These other fallacies that we can discuss later include:

Slippery Slope Fallacy (الانزلاق بالنتائج): The fallacy works by moving from a seemingly benign premise through long series of steps to an improbable extreme that no one accepts. Slippery slope concept is not always wrong, some slippery slope arguments can be valid. But using slippery slope as basis for argument requires great wisdom.

The slippery slope is the basis for the Fiqh rule cut the pretext (سد الذرائع). But excessive use of this role will result in major harm by imposing major restrictions on Muslims because you can prohibit many things that are hallal on the basis of the slippery slope argument because they can lead to something bad.

False Dilemma/ False Dichotomy Fallacy: This fallacy involves limiting the options to two when there are in fact more options to choose from. Like saying you are with us or against us. Or say you either support going or you are coward. This fallacy is often used as manipulative tool to polarize the audience by honoring one side and demonizing the other.

The bandwagon Fallacy (مع الجماعة): The fallacy is made by assuming something is true (or right, or good) because other people agree with it. Actually, you may note in the Quran that Allah says that the majority are often wrong. Allah says:

‌ۚ إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ‌ۚ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ‌ۚ ذَأَلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ (٤٠)

“Sovereignty belongs to none but Allah. He has ordained that you shall not worship anyone but Him. This is the only right path. But most of the people do not know” (Yunus 12:40)

Circular argument (المنطق الدائري): This fallacy involves making an assumption and then stating it as argument.

Hasty generalization (مغالطة التعميم): This involves making general statement without sufficient evidence to support it and then using it to reach unwarranted conclusion.

Equivocation (المراوغة): This happens when a word, phrase, or sentence is used deliberately to make the audience think you’re saying something you’re not.

Appeal to pity. The fallacy appeals to the compassion and emotional sensitivity of others when the factors mentioned are not relevant to the argument.

Red Herring Fallacy (الرنجة الحمراء): is used as a distraction from the main topic of discussion to something else that seems to be relevant but it is not really on-topic. Often, a red herring fallacy can be difficult to identify because it’s not always clear how different topics relate.

The phrase “red herring” refers to the training device that is used to test how well a hunting dog could track a scent without getting distracted. The method involves placing a red herring nearby because it has an aroma that is so strong and delectable to dogs.

Inshallah, we can expand on these fallacies and how the disbelievers used them in future talks.

DUA

content:
Surat Al-Tariq in Light of the Signs of the Hour (علامات الساعة)

الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينة ونستغفره، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا، ومن سيئات أعمالنا
وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن سيدنا محمدًا عبده ورسوله

This talk is continuation of last week talk whose title was “The 4th Element of Islam The Pre-Hour Signs (علامات الساعة)”. I started last week talk by reference to well known the Hadeath in which the Prophet (PBUH) answered 4 questions that was given to him by the Archangel Gibreal and these were: what is Islam, what is Eman, what is Ehsan and what are the signs of the hour. And the Prophet told the companions that these are the basics of our religion.

These 4 elements address all aspect of our life, current and future.

The definition of Islam provides the physical rituals that involve our personal relationship with Allah.

The definition of Eman provides the articles of belief that are settled in our heart.

The definition of Ehsan provides the control that we must consider in our relationship with all creations and this control is that we are under continuous monitoring by Allah.

The fourth element of religion is signs of the day judgment and these represent future events that we, as Muslims, need to know to be prepared for them, particularly since most of these signs represent tribulation and challenges.

I stated that there are two main reasons for studying the signs of the hour:
1. Develop technologies that protect humanity in face of these expected calamities
2. Allow for better understanding certain Surat in the Quran that seems unclear without taking these signs into account.

And I’ll add a 3rd reason and this is to realize that these signs are given as warning that unless mankind follows the commands of Allah, they will be destroyed as Allah have destroyed nations before them. Unfortunately, when we look at the world today, we note that we are committing a combination of the violations that each one of them caused previous nations to be destroyed. Therefore, we should expect that our punishment will be a combination of all past punishments. All you need to do is to study the violation committed by the people of Prophets Nuh, Saleh, Shoaib, Lot, and Moses and their form of punishments to know what will be falling us when we engage on all the violations.

In this talk, I plan to, inshallah, to focus on the 2nd objective and this is how to provide better understanding of some Suarts in the Quran in light of these signs. I’ll focus on Surat Al-Tariq to present new possible understanding. This does not mean that other tafseers that you have read are wrong. They are correct and provide valuable interpretations and I am just making another addition. One of the miracles of the Quran is that its verses allow for multiple lessons to be drawn are as long as each lesson does not violate the rules of the Arabic language and does not create contradiction with other verses in the Quran.

To set the stage of the understanding of Surat Al-Tariq in light of the signs of the hour. Let me remind you of few verses in the Quran that provide justification for the explanation I plan to offer.

The Prophet (PBUH) threatened the disbelievers with a cosmic event that will befall them if they continue to reject his message. They said to him that they will not believe until he brings the punishment on them as he claimed. As Allah revealed in suart Al-Isra, they said that they will not believe until:

تُسۡقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا (٩٢)
“you cause the sky to fall upon us in pieces, as you claimed,.” (Al-Isra 17:90-92)

The same threat was confirmed in Surat Al-Shuara (الشُّعَرَاء) with some details that whatever will fall on them from the sky will cause them to stand with their necks stretched so their eyes will continue focusing on it:

إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡہِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً۬ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَـٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ (الشُّعَرَاء)
“If We will, We can send down on them from a sign from the sky on which their necks will stay in submission.” (Al-Shuara 26:3-4)

As long as there are people who continue to reject the Prophet (PBUH), this threat of something falling form the sky as punishment will remain. In Surat Saba, the warning was repeated and was expanded to include sink holes to swallow them.

إِن نَّشَأۡ نَخۡسِفۡ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ نُسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡہِمۡ كِسَفً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٲلِكَ لَأَيَةً۬ لِّكُلِّ عَبۡدٍ۬ مُّنِيبٍ۬ (٩)
“If We so will, We would make the earth swallow them up, or cause pieces of the sky to fall upon them. Surely, in this there is a sign for every continuously repenting servant. “(Saba 34:9)

Then we find more details on the form of expected punishment in Surat Al-Dukhan and this involves a visible smoke that will engulf the earth:

بَلۡ هُمۡ فِى شَكٍّ۬ يَلۡعَبُونَ (٩) فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ۬ مُّبِينٍ۬ (١٠) يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ (١١)
“But they, being in doubt, are playing around. (9) So, wait for a day when the sky will produce visible smoke (10) That will envelop people. This will be a painful punishment.” (Al-Dukhan 44:9-11)

In Surat Al-Nijm, Allah gives the warning that this punishment is imminent:

أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأَزِفَةُ (٥٧) لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ (٥٨)
“The Imminent (event) has approached. (57) There is no one, beside Allah, can disclose it (can remove it).” (Al-Najm 53:57-58)

This punishment will be very expansive that every town will see it as we can infer from Surat Al-Isra:

وَإِن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحۡنُ مُهۡلِڪُوهَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَـٰمَةِ أَوۡ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابً۬ا شَدِيدً۬اۚ كَانَ ذَٲلِكَ فِى ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ مَسۡطُورًا (٥٨)
“There is no town but We are to destroy it before the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with severe punishment. That is set forth in the Book.” (Al-Isra 17:58)

The implementation of the threat to have the sky falling on the disbelievers
Based on these verses as well as others, we understand that mankind are subjected to a threat that will come to them from the sky above and this will create major smoke that will engulf the earth and results in major damages that will involve floods, earthquakes, fires, etc. The verses in the Quran also suggest that this punishment is imminent and will come suddenly when people think that their technological advances have made them in control and thus encouraged them to transgress beyond the bounds. This punishment will be so severe that will erase every advancement man has done. Allah says in Surat Yunus:

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زُخۡرُفَهَا وَٱزَّيَّنَتۡ وَظَنَّ أَهۡلُهَآ أَنَّہُمۡ قَـٰدِرُونَ عَلَيۡہَآ أَتَٮٰهَآ أَمۡرُنَا لَيۡلاً أَوۡ نَهَارً۬ا فَجَعَلۡنَـٰهَا حَصِيدً۬ا كَأَن لَّمۡ تَغۡنَ بِٱلۡأَمۡسِۚ كَذَٲلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأَيَـٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ۬ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ (٢٤)
“Until when the earth took on its ornament and was fully embellished, and its people thought that they had control over it, Our command comes to it at night or by day, and We turned it into a clean-mown harvest, as if it had not flourished a day earlier. This is how We elaborate the revelations for people who reflect.” (Yunus 10:24)

If you examine the different verses in the Quran that discuss the punishments of the past nations, it was always because of dominant violation that make them prosecute the believers and the weak. If you examine our situation now, you note that we are committing their combined sins and the believers are prosecuted all over the world including in the so-called Muslim countries.

So, we should not be surprised that Allah’s punishment is ready to be released upon us and this punishment will not befall specific nation as in the past but the whole earth because the whole earth are guilty either by directly committing the atrocities or by fully aware of it and doing nothing to prevent it. Allah makes it clear that being passive is a crime as He said in Surat Al-Maeda:

لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسۡرَٲٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَۚ ذَٲلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ (٧٨) كَانُواْ لَا يَتَنَاهَوۡنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ۬ فَعَلُوهُۚ لَبِئۡسَ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ (٧٩)
“A curse by the tongue of Dawud and ‘Isa, Son of Maryam was pronounced on those who disbelieve from among the children of Israeli because they disobeyed and used to transgress. (78) They did not restrain one another from any evil they committed. Evil indeed is what they have been doing.!” (Al-Maeda 5:79)

So, the curse will not only be on the transgressors but also upon those who are watching it and doing nothing to prevent it.

But, as in the past, there will always be people, though small in number, who remain to be true believers and stand against the injustice and they are the one who have been prosecuted by the transgressors. And, as in the past, those righteous people will be saved, though they will witness the total annihilation of the earth around them. Those were the people who restarted a new righteous society.

Because of the small number of those believers among the massive number of the transgressors, verse in the Quran suggest that Allah will send angels with commands to comb the earth to pick them one by one. The process will be as we comb the wheat from the chaff. This picture can be drawn from verse 2 in Surat An-Naziat (النَّازِعَات) (79) in which Allah describes the roles of certain the angels by saying: (وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشۡطً۬ا) “By those who gently draw out (the believers).”

But how would the angels know those few who are truly righteous, obviously Allah knows the inward of everyone and what we hide in our chests as He says in verse 9 of Surat Al-Tariq (86) (يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآٮِٕرُ) “On the day in which all that is hidden thoughts will be searched out”.

Referring to the begging of Surat Al-Dukhan, we read

حمٓ (١) وَٱلۡڪِتَـٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ (٢) إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَـٰهُ فِى لَيۡلَةٍ۬ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ‌ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ (٣) فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ (٤) أَمۡرً۬ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآ‌ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ (٥)
Ha Mim . (1) By the manifest Book, (2) We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people). (3) In that (night), every wise matter is allocated (4) As a command from Us – Indeed we are sending. (Al-Dukhan 44:1-5)

We can connect this command to the oath in the beginning of Surat Al-Naziat:

فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٲتِ أَمۡرً۬ا (٥) يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ (٦)
By those who manage the command (of Allah). (5) On the day of the violent shock with bursting sound. (An-Naziat 79:5-6)

One can connect Allah’s command that will be managed by the angels and will be in the form of violent shock with bursting sound (الرَّاجِفَةُ) with verses 10 and 11 of Surat Al-Dukhan in which Allah describes the form of punishment associated with the command. By saying:

فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ۬ مُّبِينٍ۬ (١٠) يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ (١١)
“Wait for a day when the sky will produce visible smoke (10) That will envelop people. This will be a painful punishment.” (Al-Dukhan 44:10-11)

With this background we can move to provide reflection on Suart Al-Tariq in light of these signs of the hour that I briefly mentioned, let me set the possible scenario and see if it fits the verses of Surat Al-Tariq.

Our earth is surrounded with protective cover to protect it from many cosmic events that can cause major destruction to the earth and some of these events have occurred in the past. One can speculate on two scenarios that will come from the sky above us that makes all people freeze looking at it as it approaches and whatever comes from the sky will create violent shock, bursting sound, major fire that will engulf the earth with smoke and will cause massive death and destructions to our civilization by rendering all our communication technology and electrical systems useless.

The two possible scenarios are massive asteroid or huge solar flare that will be able to pass thru the upper atmosphere that protects the earth from such events that occur frequently but rarely reach the earth.

But on one day, Allah will allow one of these events, asteroid or solar flare, to pierce thru the earth protective layer and it will come knocking on the surface penetrating it, resulting in major destruction and massive death. According to researchers in earth and planetary sciences such event can wipe out an entire continent or even cause civilization to collapse. This will not be the end of life on earth, but the beginning of new civilization form those righteous people whom Allah will save similar to what happed in the past. Allah destroyed many past nations and only saved the Prophet and the few believers and they were the catalysts to form new society. As example, the destruction that happened to the people of Prophets Nuh, Lut, Saleh, Shoaib and others.

The similitude of this image is like when many sperms tries to penetrate the egg in the mother womb but only one of them will be able to reach the egg and penetrate it to start the creation of a new life for a new human being and the rest will be destroyed.

This scenario should not be unrealistic since Allah who created the first creation, can allow the recreation of another one.

When this massive event happens, it will not wipe out all people, the lives of the righteous ones will be protected and they will be saved. But the evils ones will have no one at that time to support and protect them.

You may ask whether this means that Muslims will be saved, the answer is that only those who are truly righteous will be saved. Those who are righteous are those whom Allah identifies based on exposing what is in their hearts and not based on what they claim.

As I stated such major cosmic event has happened in the past causing major destructions and wiping civilization to have new ones start. The sky sent before asteroids or solar flares and as a result the earth has been subjected to many faults and fractures. So, what is planned in the futures is a repeat to what happened in the past, thought it will be on a far massive scale.

The Quran informs us of future events and it is up to us to take heed. As in the past, though it was on limited scale, people plot to prosecute and get rid of the righteous and true servants of Allah. You can see this happening in front of everyone in many countries including the so-called Muslim countries. Do you think Allah is not aware of this, obviously He is but Allah has His Own plan that will be executed on His time. He wants to give those transgressors time, so when He destroys them, they will have no excuse. Allah says in Surat Al-Qamar:

كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَـٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٍ۬ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ (٤٢) أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ۬ مِّنۡ أُوْلَـٰٓٮِٕكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَاءَةٌ۬ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ (٤٣)
“They rejected all Our signs; so We seized them a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful. (42) Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?” (Al-Qamar 54:42)

Let us now focus on Surat Al-Tariq. The traditional tafseer considers that Surat Al-Tariq discusses 5 topics: 1) astrophysics, 2) embryology, 3) exposing man’s secrets, 4) geography and nature, and 5) the plots of man and the plans of Allah.

But Keeping this scenario that I suggested in your mind, we will see, inshallah, that Surat Al-Tariq presents one topic that is related to cosmic events and that the surat ending is connected to its beginning.

(Al-Tariq 86:1-17)

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ (١) وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ (٢)
By the sky and the one that knocks. And what may let you know what is one that knocks

ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ (٣)
it is the piercing star
(Allah makes an oath the star that will be piercing the earth from the sky crating large knocking sound)

إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ۬ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٌ۬ (٤)
There is no soul, but there is a protector over him.
(In spite of this major event that come to the earth, Allah is the savior and protector of every soul)

فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ (٥) خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ۬ دَافِقٍ۬ (٦) يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآٮِٕبِ (٧)
So, let man consider what he is created form. (5) He is created of spouting water (6) That comes out from between the loins and the ribs. .
(Let man reflects on the similitude of the piercing star that will penetrate the earth to cause damage, yet creates new life which is like the one sperm that comes out of spouting semen and penetrates the egg to create a new life).

إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ۬ (٨)
Surely, He (Allah) is Powerful to bring him back (8)
(while the piercing star will destroy humanity but Allah can create new humanity)

يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآٮِٕرُ (٩) فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ۬ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ۬ (١٠)
On a day when all the secrets will be exposed, (9) And everyone will have neither power nor supporter. .
(When the destruction by the piercing star happens, it will expose the secrets of the wicked and at that time, they will have no power nor supporter to save them)

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ (١١)
By the sky that repeats

وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ (١٢)
and by the earth that cracks open. .
(By the sky that caused destruction before and by the earth that formed cracks and faults, man should not be surprised when punishment comes to him as it came to those before him)

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٌ۬ فَصۡلٌ۬ (١٣) وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ (١٤)
This is a decisive word, (13) And it is not a joke.
(This account of punishment is not a joke; this is serious warning to mankind).

إِنَّہُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدً۬ا (١٥) وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدً۬ا (١٦)
They (the disbelievers) are plotting a scheme, (15) And I am (Allah) devising a plan.
(Wicked people keep setting plans to prosecute and destroy the righteous and I, Allah, have His own plan)

فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدً۬ا (١٧)
So, leave the disbelievers for a moment; give them respite for a while.
Let the disbelievers keep with their devious plots, give them respite until Allah executes His plan. What is the plan for the disbelievers? Go to the beginning of the Surat)

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ (١) وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ (٢) ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ (٣)
By the sky and the one that knocks. And what may let you know what is one that knocks, it is the piercing star
(Allah makes an oath by the star that will be piercing the earth from the sky crating large knocking sound and destroying the disbelievers)

In reflecting on this surat as we presented it, we can say that every human being on this earth has a choice to make. Either to accept the final message of Allah and follow its commands and be saved to enjoy the renewal of earth and its new just and merciful civilization, or stay on the path that is contradicting Allah’s message thru disbelief and atrocities and face the consequences.

In light of the signs that will precede the hour, as we presented the possible understanding of Surat Al-Tariq, we can also draw additional insight from Surat An-Naziat (النَّازِعَات) (79) considering that the oath in the start of the Surat is by the angels that Allah will send to execute His order to destroy at come with violent shock with bursting sound and the angels will come rushing extracting the souls of the disbelievers and saving the few believers.

وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرۡقً۬ا (١) وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشۡطً۬ا (٢) وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبۡحً۬ا (٣) فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبۡقً۬ا (٤) فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٲتِ أَمۡرً۬ا (٥) يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ (٦) تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ (٧) قُلُوبٌ۬ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ۬ وَاجِفَةٌ (٨) أَبۡصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ۬ (٩)

I’ll leave this Surat to you to reflect on and compare your new reflections with the tafseers that you will read.

My advice to myself first and to you is to examine our heart, Allah will expose our secrets and only those whose heart is clean will be saved.

The sign I discussed today is the first of the major signs, but there are many other signs that are classified as minor that have already materialized. I discussed few last time and in the next few minutes let me highlight another one to ensure that we don’t fail in facing it. The Prophet (PBUH) said that before the Hour there will be proliferation of writing and spread of lying.

With the spread of social media, everyone now writes and many of what is written is false. Unfortunately, people spread the false information without any verification. You must have received from your contacts ahadeath and when you verify their authenticity you discover that they are fabricated. In this case, not only the person who wrote them is sinful but everyone who shared them is sinful and claiming that the Prophet (PBUH) said something that he did not say is not a small sin, it is a major sin.

عن المغيرة بن شعبة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: (إن كذبا عليَّ ليس ككذب على أحد، من كذب علي متعمدا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار) رواه البخاري، ورواه مسلم
“”Whoever (intentionally) ascribes to me what I have not said then (surely) let him occupy his seat in Hell-fire.”

So, please don’t forward any information you receive until you verify it. Keep in mind that it takes the truth about six times as long as falsehood to reach 1,500 people. And it is real people who spread the falsehood.

Allah programmed us to be trust others and we internally presume that what is presented to us is true, but with the warning of the Prophet (PBUH) that lies will be wide spread, we should be careful. (END)

عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن بين يدي الساعة: ظهور القلم» (رواه أحمد)
“A sign of the hour is the proliferation of writing.” (Ahmad)

عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنَّ أَمَامَ الدَّجَّالِ سِنِينَ خَدَّاعَةً يُكَذَّبُ فِيهَا الصَّادِقُ وَيُصَدَّقُ فِيهَا الْكَاذِبُ وَيُؤْتَمَنُ فِيهَا الْخَائِنُ وَيُخَوَّنُ فِيهَا الْأَمِينُ وَيَنْطِقُ فِيهَا الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ قِيلَ وَمَا الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ قَالَ الْفُوَيْسِقُ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي أَمْرِ الْعَامَّةِ) مسند أحمد بن حنبل
Anas ibn Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Verily, preceding the False Messiah will be years of deception, in which the truthful are belied, the liars are believed, the trustworthy are discredited, the treacherous are trusted, and the disgraceful speak.” It was said, “Who are the disgraceful?” The Prophet said, “Little wicked men who speak about the affairs of common people.” (Musnad Aḥmad)

عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَيأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ سَنَوَاتٌ خَدَّاعَاتٌ يُصَدَّقُ فِيهَا الْكَاذِبُ وَيُكَذَّبُ فِيهَا الصَّادِقُ وَيُؤْتَمَنُ فِيهَا الْخَائِنُ وَيُخَوَّنُ فِيهَا الْأَمِينُ وَيَنْطِقُ فِيهَا الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ قِيلَ وَمَا الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ التَّافِهُ فِي أَمْرِ الْعَامَّةِ ) سنن ابن ماجه
Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said, “The end of time, years of treachery will come over people in which liars are believed and the truthful are denied, the deceitful are trusted and the trustworthy are considered traitors, and the disgraceful will deliver speeches.” It was said, “Who are the disgraceful?” The Prophet said, “Petty men with authority over the common people.” (Sunan Ibn Mājah)

Dua

The 4 Elements of Religion
There is well known hadeath that was reported by Omar ibn Al-Khtaab (رضي هللا عنه) who said:

قالُفأخبرنيُعنُالساعةُقالُماُالمسؤولُعنهاُبأعلمُمنُالسائلُقالُفأخبرنيُعنُأماراتهاُقالُأنُتلدُاۡلمة ربتهاُوأنُترىُالحفاةُالعراةُالعالةُرعاءُالشاةُيتطاولونُفيُالبنيانُقالُثمُانطلقُفلبثتُملياُثمُقالُلي ياُعمرُ أتدريُمنُالسائلُقلتُهللاُورسولهُأعلمُقالُفإنهُجبريلُأتآكم يعلمكم دينكم” (رواهُمسلم)

Translation:
Omar ibn Al-Khtaab (رضي هللا عنه) said: One day, while we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, a man came whose clothes were exceedingly white and whose hair was exceedingly black. There were no signs of travel seen on him and none of us knew him. He approached and sat down by the Prophet (PBUH) resting his knees against his and placing the palms of his hands on his thighs.
Then he said: “O Muhammad, inform me about Islam.” The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Islam is to testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish the prayers, to pay the Zakat, to fast in Ramadan, and to make the pilgrimage (Hajj) to the House if you are able to do so.” He said: “You have spoken the truth.” We were amazed that he was asking him and telling him and them affirming what the Messenger said.
Then the man said, “So inform me about Eman (Faith).” The Prophet (PBUH) said, “It is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and to believe in the Divine Decree (Qadr), both the good and the evil thereof.”
Then man said: You have spoken the truth. Then inform me about Ihsan.” The Prophet (PBUH) said, “It is to worship Allah as though you see Him and if you are not able to see Him then He sees you.”
The man said: “Then inform me about the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment).” The Prophet (PBUH) said: “The one questioned is not more knowledgeable about it than the questioner.” The man said, “Then, inform me about its signs.” The Prophet (PBUH) said, “That the maid gives birth to her Mistress and that you will see the barefooted, naked, destitute shepherds competing in construction of high buildings.”
Then the man departed and I stayed for a time. The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) asked me: “do you know who the questioner was?” I said, “Allah and His Messenger know best.”
He said, “He was Jibreel who came to teach you your religion.” (Related by Muslim)

The 4 Elements of Religion address all aspects of your life, current and future:
• The definition of Islam provides the physical rituals that are involved in your personal relationship with Allah.
• The definition of Eman provides the articles of belief that are settled in your heart.
• The definition of Ehsan provides the control of your relationship with all creations under the continuous monitoring by Allah.
• The fourth element provides some signs of the hour (day of judgment) and these represent future events that you, as a Muslim, need to know to be prepared for it and establish plans to face them when they arrive, particularly since most of these signs represent tribulation and challenges.

Is knowing the Signs of the Hour important?
• The importance of the events that precede Hour for Muslims is demonstrated by Allah revealing several of them in the Quran and by the Prophet (PBUH) providing many additional details on his own.
• These events will have dramatic impact on how we live on earth and we, as Muslims, who have been told about them, should be the most prepared to face them.

Number of signs and their classification
• Based on the Quran and the authentic hadeath, scholars have identified more than eighty (80) signs of the Hour.
• Scholars suggested two main methods for classification:
1. Classify them as “minor signs” and “major signs.”
2. Classify them as signs that have passed, signs that can be observed at present,” and “signs that have yet to occur.”

Some of the Signs that have already been fulfilled
The Prophet (PBUH) mentioned two signs in the hadeath we discussed:
1. The maid gives birth to her Mistress.
• Past explanation was that this is a metaphor (مجاز) for the disrespect of the daughter to her mother.
• Now we can interpret this sign literally (حقيقي) by the establishment of the womb for hire and the surrogate mother business. Poor women are paid to carry the child of the rich couples.
2. The barefooted, naked, destitute shepherds competing in construction of high buildings.
• now we are witnessing the fulfillment of this sign when we hear of the people in Arabia competing on who has the highest building.

Interesting pre-hour sign that has recently been fulfilled
It is reported by Abi Saeed Al-Khudry (أبي سعيد الخدري) that the Prophet (PBUH) said:
قالُأبيُسعيدُالخدريُقالُرسولُهللاُصلىُهللاُعليهُوسلم: “والذيُنفسيُبيدهُالُتقومُالساعةُحتىُتكلمُ الرجلُعذبةُسوطهُوشراكُنعلهُوتخبرهُبماُأحدثُأهلهُمنُبعدهُ” (رواهُأحمدُوُالترمذيُ)
“By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! The Hour will not come until the tip of a man’s hip and the straps on his sandal (shoe) speak to him of what occurred with his family after he left.”
• Early Muslims accepted this pre-Hour event and designated the hadeeth as good but strange (غريبُحسن) since they could not imagine it.
• But we see its fulfillment now with the advent of cellphones and pager.

Why knowing the Pre-Hour Signs is Important?
1. Focus on developing technologies that protect humanity in face of the expected calamities.
2. Allow for better understanding of certain Surahs in the Quran that seem unclear without taking these signs into account.

Some Examples:
Technology planning to allow survival when encountering some signs of the Hour:
• Protection Against Smoke/Dust Storm
• Surviving without the Sun: Planting in the shade and underwater
• Impact of Earthquakes: Earthquake Resistant Buildings
• Protection Against Random Killing
• Effect of Asteroid Hitting earth / Changes in the Solar System
• Loss of all satellite communications

All Messengers told their followers of the Signs of the Hour
• Because of the importance of the pre-hour signs, Allah revealed them to all His Messengers. Several of the signs that are revealed in the Quran and in the sayings of our Prophet (PBUH) also exist in the Torah and the Bible and even in far older religious books.
• The question is not whether these signs will happen, the question is when will they happen. Since we don’t know when, we should always be prepared to face them when they happen. This is no different than being prepared for death when it happens though none of us knows when his death will happen.

The 2nd main benefit of studying the signs of the hour
• Knowing the signs allows for better understanding certain Surahs in the Quran that seem unclear without taking these signs into account.
• Many of the signs of the hour in the Quran are related to punishments that the Prophet (PBUH) threatened the disbelievers with but have not been fulfilled during his life and will be fulfilled after the Prophet’s death. This reinforces a very important point:
• The Prophet’s message was neither solely for Quraysh and the Arabs nor for the time of his mission.
• The Prophet’s message is for all people and for all times until the coming of the hour.

content:
The 4th Element pf Islam – The Pre-Hour Signs (علامات الساعة)

There is well known hadeath that was reported by Omar ibn Al-Khtaab (عمر رضي الله) who said
عن عمر رضي الله عنه قال “بينما نحن جلوس عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات يوم إذ طلع علينا رجل شديد بياض الثياب شديد سواد الشعر لا يرى عليه أثر السفر ولا يعرفه منا أحد حتى جلس إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأسند ركبتيه إلى ركبتيه ووضع كفيه على فخذيه  قال يا محمد أخبرني على الإسلام فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الإسلام أن تشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله وتقيم الصلاة وتؤتي الزكاة وتصوم رمضان وتحج البيت إن استطعت إله سبيلا قال صدقت قال فعجبنا له يسأله ويصدقه       قال فأخبرني عن الإيمان قال أن تؤمن بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر وتؤمن بالقدر خيره وشره قال صدقت قال فأخبرني عن الإحسان قال أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه فإن لم تكن تراه فإنه يراك قال فأخبرني عن الساعة قال ما المسؤول عنها بأعلم من السائل قال فأخبرني عن أماراتها قال أن تلد الأمة ربتها وأن ترى الحفاة العراة العالة رعاء الشاة يتطاولون في البنيان قال ثم انطلق فلبثت مليا ثم قال لي يا عمر أتدري من السائل قلت الله ورسوله أعلم قال فإنه جبريل أتآكم يعلمكم دينكم” رواه مسلم
One day, while we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), a man came whose clothes were exceedingly white and whose hair was exceedingly black. There were no signs of travel seen on him and none of us knew him. He approached and sat down by the Prophet (PBUH) resting his knees to his and placing the palms of his hands on his thighs. Then he said: “O Muhammad, inform me about Islam.”
The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: “Islam is to testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish the prayer, to pay the Zakat, to fast in Ramadan, and to make the pilgrimage (Hajj) to the House (i.e.the Ka’bah) if you are able to do so.”
The man said, “You have spoken the truth.”  We were amazed that he was asking him and telling him and them affirming what the Messenger said.
Then the man said, “So inform me about Eman (Faith).”
The Prophet (PBUH) said, “It is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and to believe in the Divine Decree (Qadr), both the good and the bad.”
Then man said:  You have spoken the truth. Then inform me about Ihsan.”
The Prophet (PBUH), “It is to worship Allah as though you see Him and if you are not able to see Him then He sees you.”
The man said: “Then inform me about the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment).”
The Prophet (PBUH) said: “The one being questioned is not more knowledgeable about it than the questioner.”
The man said, “Then, inform me about its signs.”
The Prophet (PBUH) said, “That the maid gives birth to her Mistress and that you will see the barefooted, naked, destitute shepherds competing in construction of high buildings.”
Then the man departed and I stayed for a time. The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) asked me: “do you know who the questioner was?”
I said, “Allah and His Messenger know best.”
He said, “He was Jibreel who came to teach you your religion.” (Related by Muslim)
I want to place special emphasis on the last statement that was made by the Prophet (PBUH) which is “He came to teach you your religion”.
This means that the religion of Islam involves four elements ad these are:  Islam, Eman, Ihsan and the signs of the Day of Judgement.
These 4 elements address all aspect of your life, current and future.  
The definition of Islam provides the physical rituals that are involved in your personal relationship with Allah. 
The definition of Eman provides the articles of belief that are settled in your heart.   
The definition of Ehsan provides the control of your relationship with all creations under the continuous monitoring by Allah. 
The fourth element provides some signs of the day judgment and these represent future events that you, as a Muslim, need to know to be prepared for it and establish plans to face when they arrive, particularly since most of these signs represent tribulation and challenges.
No one knows the time of the Hour (the day of Judgement) except Allah and this is clear in the Quran
 
يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَٮٰهَا‌ۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى‌ۖ لَا يُجَلِّيہَا لِوَقۡتِہَآ إِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ ثَقُلَتۡ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٲتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ‌ۚ لَا تَأۡتِيكُمۡ إِلَّا بَغۡتَةً۬‌ۗ يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِىٌّ عَنۡہَا‌ۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَڪۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ (١٨٧)
“They ask you about the Hour, “When is it due to happen?” Say, “Its knowledge is only with my Lord. No one can unfold it except He at its time. 
It weighs heavy in the heavens and the earth. It shall not come upon you but suddenly.” They ask you as if you were aware of it. Say, “Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most of the people do not know.” (Al-Arfaf 7:187)
 
يَسۡــٴَـلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا (٦٣)
“People ask you about the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment). Say,” Its knowledge is only with Allah.” And what can let you know? May be, the Hour is near.” (Al-Ahzab 33:63)
Because of these verses that affirm that only Allah know the time of the Hour, the companions refrained from asking the Prophet (PBUH) about information related to the Hour. 
Why it is important to know the signs of the hour?
Because of the importance of the events that precede Hour for Muslims, Allah revealed several of them in the Quran and the Prophet (PBUH) also provided many additional details on his own without being asked.
Why, we should care about these events that will occur before the Hour!  These are major events that will have dramatic impact on how we live on earth and we, as Muslims, who have been told about them, should be the most prepared to face them.  (The question is:  are we doing any preparation!!)
How many Signs and their classification methods:
Based on the Quran and the authentic hadeath, scholars have identified more than eighty (80) signs of the Hour but they differed in the method of their classifications.
Some classify them as “minor signs” and “major signs.” Others classify them as signs that have passed, signs that can be observed at present,” and “signs that have yet to occur.
While the Prophet (PBUH) told us in the hadeath we discussed of two of the events that will occur before the last hour.  We have actually observed the fulfillment of these two signs in our time. 
The Prophet (PBUH) said that one of the signs is that the maid gives birth to her Mistress.  In the past the explanation was that this is a metaphor (مجاز) for the disrespect of the daughter to her mother and treating her as maid.  But now we can interpret literary (حقيقي) after we witness now the business of the womb for hire and availability of surrogate mothers.  This business takes advantage of the poor women by paying them money to carry the child of the rich couples.
The prophet (PBUH) also mentioned another sign and this is that the barefooted, naked, destitute shepherds competing in construction of high buildings. The people whom the Prophet (PBUH) was talking about are the people of Arabia and now we are witnessing the fulfillment of this sign when we hear of the completion on who has the highest building.
List of some of the tallest buildings in the Arab League
Rank Name City Height
1 Burj Khalifa Dubai 828 m (2,717 ft)
2 Abraj Al-Bait Clock Tower Mecca 601 m (1,972 ft)
3 Marina 101 Dubai 425 m (1,394 ft)
3 Princess Tower Dubai 414 m (1,358 ft)
4 Al Hamra Tower Kuwait City 413 m (1,355 ft)
5 23 Marina Dubai 392.4 m (1,287 ft)
6 Capital Market Authority Headquarters Riyadh 385 m (1,263 ft)
7 Burj Mohammed Bin Rashid Abu Dhabi 381 m (1,250 ft)
In addition to the two signs that were given in this hadeath, both the Quran and other hadeath of the Prophet (PBUH) identified many other signs.  Some of them have already occurred and others remains.  One of the interesting per-hour account was reported by Abi Saeed Al-Khudry (أبي سعيد الخدري) that the Prophet (PBUH) said:
 
قال أبي سعيد الخدري قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: “والذي نفسي بيده لا تقوم الساعة حتى تكلم الرجل عذبة سوطه وشراك نعله وتخبره بما أحدث أهله من بعده ” (رواه أحمد و الترمذي (
“By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! The Hour will not be established come until the tip of a man's hip and the straps on his sandal (shoe) speak to him of what occurred with his family after he left.” 
While early Muslims accepted this pre-Hour event as real, they were not have been able to interpret what it meant and thus they designated the hadeeth as good but strange (حسن غريب).  But we see its fulfillment now with the advent of cellphones and pager and their advancements.   
Why it is important of knowing the Pre-Hour Signs
1. Focus on developing technologies that protect humanity in face of the expected calamities
2. Allow for better understanding certain Surat in the Quran that seems unclear without taking these signs into account.
Let me illustrate the first objective of the importance of knowing about the pre-hour signs by presenting few of the pre-Hour signs that we have been warned about thru the Quran and the hadeath and offer a suggestion on what technologies need to be developed to face them to allow our survival and that of humanity:
Dust Storm: It has been revealed that there will major dust storm that will engulf the earth and shield the sun for a year.  What we need to do to allow us to survive under such a condition.  
Shouldn’t we work on develop efficient air filtration systems to allow us to survive under dusty environment.
Shouldn’t we start developing technologies to allow for food production in the absence of the sun?
Earthquakes:  It has been revealed that after certain cosmic events, the number and the intensity of earthquakes will increase and sink holes will be developed.  What should we do to ensure that our building survive earthquakes? 
Shouldn’t at least we start developing building codes that ensure that our homes and business withstand these earthquakes.
Shouldn’t we start developing methods to minimize the impact of sink holes on building and on roads.
Random killing: It has been revealed that random killing will become so spread.  What we should do to protect ourselves?
Shouldn’t we plan on how to set systems to prevent it from coming to our society and how to protect ourselves if we face it?
Changes in the solar system: It has been revealed that the earth will be bombarded by star or massive asteroid that will be able to penetrate the earth atmosphere and not only cause major damage such as creating the dust storm and increasing earthquakes but can also render all our communication satellites useless.  What should we do to survive without all satellite-based communication systems?
Shouldn’t we plan to set systems to allow us to continue our communication in the absence of satellites by for example increasing the number of communication cables.
Shouldn’t we keep current paper copy of our records such as banking accounts to ensure that our wealth is not lost thru the loss of all cloud stored records?
Shouldn’t we develop plans to protect ourselves when all our defense systems that are based on satellite communications including GPS rendered useless.
We need to realize that because of the importance of the pre-hour signs, Allah revealed them to all His Messengers.  Therefore, you will find many of them that are revealed in the Quran and in the sayings of our Prophet (PBUH) also exist in the Torah and the Bible and even in far older religious books. 
What I have presented are just few examples on why it is important to know of these pre-hour signs to prepare for them because the question is not whether these signs will happen, the question is when will they happen.  Since we don’t know when, we should always be prepared to face them when they happen.  This is no different than being prepared for death when it happens though none of us knows when his death will happen. 
The 2nd main objective of studying the signs of the hour is to allow for better understanding certain Surat in the Quran that seems unclear without taking these signs into account.
Many of the signs of the hour in the Quran are related to punishments that the Prophet (PBUH) threatened the disbelievers with but they have not been fulfilled during his life and will be fulfilled after the Prophet’s death.   This reinforces a very important point:
 “The Prophets message was neither solely for the Quraysh and the Arabs nor for the time of his mission.  The Prophet’s message is for all people and for all times until the coming of the hour.  
Therefore, when you read of warnings, you should not limit these warning to a specific period of time, but it is for all times as long as there are people who continue to reject the message of the Prophet (PBUH).  This is clear from the following verses that confirm that the warning that Allah promised to inflict the disbelievers with will be realized either during the life of the Prophet or after his death as Allah says:
 
وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَہِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ (٤٦)
“No matter whether We show you (during your life) some of what We have promised to them, or We cause you to die Us (before it), still they have to return to Us. Then, Allah is witness over what they do.” (Yunus 10:46)
 
فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَۚقٌّ۬ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ (٧٧)
“Therefore, be patient. Surely, Allah’s promise is true. Then, (O Prophet,) whether We show you (in your life) a part of what We have promised to them, or make you die (before they are punished), in any case they have to be returned to Us.’ (Ghafir 40:77)
Also, in Surat Al-Rad
وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَـٰغُ وَعَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡحِسَابُ (٤٠)
“And if We show you (O prophet) some of what We have promised to them, or We cause you to die (before that), in both cases you have only to convey the message, and on Us is the reckoning.’ (Al-Rad 13:40)
Did the Prophet (PBUH) threatened the disbelievers with punishments and what were their nature.
Verse 92 from Surat Al-Isra clearly shows that the Prophet (PBUH) warned the disbelievers of the sky falling on them since they were challenging him to bring on them what he promised. 
 
وَقَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفۡجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَنۢبُوعًا (٩٠) أَوۡ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ۬ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ۬ وَعِنَبٍ۬ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلۡأَنۡهَـٰرَ خِلَـٰلَهَا تَفۡجِيرًا (٩١) أَوۡ تُسۡقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا أَوۡ تَأۡتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕڪَةِ قَبِيلاً (٩٢)
“They said, “We shall never believe in you unless you cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth. (90) Or you have a garden of date palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth therein abundantly. (91) Or you cause the sky to fall upon us in pieces, as you claimed, or you bring Allah and angels before us face to face.” (Al-Isra 17:90-92)
The same threat was confirmed in Surat Al-Shuara (الشُّعَرَاء) with some details that whatever will fall on them from the sky will cause them to stand with their necks stretched so their eyes will continue be focusing on it:
 
لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ۬ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ (٣) إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡہِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً۬ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَـٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ (الشُّعَرَاء)
“It may be that thou tormenting yourself because they do not believe. (3) If We will, We can send down on them from a sign from the sky on which their necks will stay in submission.” (Al-Shuara 26:3-4)
As I said, as long as there are people who continue to reject the Prophet (PBUH), this threat of something falling form the sky as punishment will remain.  In Surat Saba, the warning was repeated and was expanded to include sink holes to swallow them.
 
أَفَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِن نَّشَأۡ نَخۡسِفۡ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ نُسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡہِمۡ كِسَفً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٲلِكَ لَأَيَةً۬ لِّكُلِّ عَبۡدٍ۬ مُّنِيبٍ۬ (٩)
“Have they not, then, looked to the sky and the earth that lies before them and behind them? If We so will, We would make the earth swallow them up, or cause pieces of the sky to fall upon them. Surely, in this there is a sign for a servant (of Allah) who turns to Him.“  (Saba 34:9)
Then we find more detailed on the form of expected punishment in Surat Al-Dukhan and this involves a visible smoke that will engulf the earth:
 
بَلۡ هُمۡ فِى شَكٍّ۬ يَلۡعَبُونَ (٩) فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ۬ مُّبِينٍ۬ (١٠) يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ۬ (١١)
“But they, being in doubt, are playing around. (9) So, wait for a day when the sky will produce visible smoke (10) That will envelop people. This will be a painful punishment. (11)” (Al-Dukhan 44:9-11)
Surat Al-Nijm gives an affirmation that the punishment will be coming, and it is approaching:
أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأَزِفَةُ (٥٧) لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ (٥٨)
“The Imminent (event) has approached. (57) There is no one, beside Allah, can disclose it (can remove it).” (Al-Najm 53:57-58)
This punishment will be very expansive that every town will see it as we can infer from Surat Al-Isra:
 
وَإِن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحۡنُ مُهۡلِڪُوهَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَـٰمَةِ أَوۡ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابً۬ا شَدِيدً۬ا‌ۚ كَانَ ذَٲلِكَ فِى ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ مَسۡطُورً۬ا (٥٨)
“There is no town but We are to destroy it before the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with severe punishment. That is set forth in the Book.” (Al-Isra 17:58)
Based on these verses, we can formulate a picture that should help us interpreting several Surat such as and Surat Al-Tariq (الطّارق) (86) and Surat An-Naziat  (النَّازعَات) (79)
I think I should stop here and next week inshallah will present the picture of the punishment from the verses of the Quran and use to give coherent meaning to Surat Al-Tariq.   Until we need inshallah next week, you may want to the tafseer of surat Al-Tariq to allow you to judge the Tafseer I plan to give, inshallah. 
Dua
